shared: positive regulation of hemoglobin biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Heme biosynthesis and erythroid heme metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the porphyrin/heme B biosynthetic route with iron-sulfur assembly and mitochondrial ABC transport, framed as heme supply for hemoglobin production.

reading_2.theme: Heme biosynthesis and mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe porphyrin and heme B synthesis, mitochondrial ABC transport and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, framed here as mitochondrial iron-cofactor biogenesis that also supplies [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] clusters for TCA enzyme maturation.

shared: tRNA aminoacylation for mitochondrial protein translation
Synthesis of wybutosine at G37 of tRNA(Phe)
aminoacyl-tRNA metabolism involved in translational fidelity

reading_1.theme: tRNA charging and modification for translational fidelity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA aminoacylation and tRNA/translation-factor modifications (wybutosine, wobble thiolation, diphthamide on EEF2), framed as maintaining decoding accuracy of the translational machinery, including special cases like selenocysteine insertion and readthrough.

reading_2.theme: tRNA aminoacylation, modification and translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, wybutosine and wobble modifications and diphthamide on EEF2, framed as fidelity of translation machinery with protein hydroxylation as a further post-translational modification.

shared: Signaling by activated point mutants of FGFR3

reading_1.theme: FGF receptor signaling and its feedback regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are ligand binding (including beta-Klotho) and FRS2/SHC adaptor cascades downstream of FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4, framed as the activating signal arm that Sprouty and FGFRL1 negatively regulate.

reading_2.theme: FGFR signalling and oncogenic FGFR mutants
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR3/4 ligand binding and FRS/SHC adaptor cascades, framed as the shared downstream signalling across FGFR family members and their activating mutants.

shared: Zinc influx into cells by the SLC39 gene family
Defective SLC39A4 causes acrodermatitis enteropathica, zinc-deficiency type (AEZ)
cellular response to zinc ion starvation
zinc ion import across plasma membrane

reading_1.theme: Zinc, manganese and iron transport and homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are zinc and manganese uptake and the iron-export disorders of ferroportin and ceruloplasmin, framed as cellular transition metal homeostasis together with transferrin, heme and copper transport.

reading_2.theme: Zinc, manganese and iron transporter homeostasis disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC39 zinc/manganese uptake and ferroportin/ceruloplasmin iron export with their genetic diseases, framed as divalent metal transport that also carries toxic cadmium.

shared: negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation
positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
establishment or maintenance of cell polarity regulating cell shape
regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping

reading_1.theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling and cell shape
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe actin filament bundling, severing, crosslinking, capping and Arp2/3 control, filopodium assembly and RHO/EPH signalling, framed as cytoskeletal regulation of cell shape and polarity coordinated with microtubules.

reading_2.theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling for cell shape and motility
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are actin filament crosslinking, severing, capping and bundling with filopodium control and Rho/Eph signalling, framed as cytoskeletal dynamics that build protrusions like lamellipodia and pseudopodia for cell motility.

shared: Inhibition of Signaling by Overexpressed EGFR

reading_1.theme: EGFR/ERBB2 receptor signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor cascades (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1, PI3K, PLC-gamma), framed as receptor tyrosine kinase signalling feeding phosphoinositide pathways.

reading_2.theme: ERBB family receptor signaling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are EGFR/ERBB2 adaptor-mediated downstream signaling, framed as the canonical core of signaling across the whole ERBB receptor family.

shared: NR1H3 & NR1H2 regulate gene expression linked to cholesterol transport and efflux
positive regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle clearance
negative regulation of macrophage derived foam cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: HDL-mediated reverse cholesterol transport and efflux
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of macrophage cholesterol efflux, LXR-driven efflux genes, apoA-I signalling and limitation of foam cell formation, framed as the cellular efflux step of reverse cholesterol transport that feeds HDL particle assembly.

reading_2.theme: HDL-mediated cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are ApoA-I/LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and HDL handling that limit foam cell formation, framed as cellular sterol homeostasis by removing cholesterol from macrophages.

shared: positive regulation of B cell proliferation
positive regulation of B cell receptor signaling pathway

positive regulation of B cell differentiation
positive regulation of humoral immune response mediated by circulating immunoglobulin
enriched in naive and memory B cells

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.

reading_1.theme: B cell activation and germinal center responses
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell activation, proliferation, BCR signaling, ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B cell differentiation, framed as T-dependent humoral immunity and its homeostatic control.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation, germinal centres and humoral memory
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are BCR signalling, T follicular helper co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27) and germinal centre B cell proliferation and differentiation toward memory, framed as the activation program that culminates in plasma cell and immunoglobulin output.

shared: Defective HK1 causes hexokinase deficiency (HK deficiency)
Defective GCK causes maturity-onset diabetes of the young 2 (MODY2)
positive regulation of glycogen biosynthetic process
negative regulation of glycogen biosynthetic process
Regulation of Glucokinase by Glucokinase Regulatory Protein

reading_1.theme: Hepatic and muscle carbohydrate and glycogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe intracellular glucose, fructose and glycogen metabolism with gluconeogenesis and their storage diseases, framed as the post-absorptive fate of hexoses taken up via intestinal digestion and transport.

reading_2.theme: Glycogen and hexose fuel metabolism and its inherited disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glycogen synthesis and breakdown, glucose phosphorylation, fructose and glycerol entry and gluconeogenesis together with the glycogen storage and sugar-metabolism diseases, framed as the storage and release of carbohydrate fuel for glucose homeostasis, which the additional pathways extend to glycolytic flux control, lactate/pyruvate output and energy buffering.

shared: Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Alveolar Cells
positive regulation of mammary gland epithelial cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Mammary alveolar development and lactation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are mammary alveolar epithelial proliferation, differentiation and lactation, framed as the secretory branch of the mammary epithelial lineage hierarchy.

reading_2.theme: Mammary gland development and lactation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the alveolar/secretory stage of mammary epithelium (alveolar lineage, epithelial proliferation and differentiation, lactation), framed as the functional endpoint of the ductal branching morphogenesis in the additional set.

shared: positive regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle
regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication initiation
negative regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication

reading_1.theme: DNA replication initiation and G1/S transition
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are replication origin licensing and firing and the E2F program, framed as S-phase entry monitored by replication stress checkpoints.

reading_2.theme: DNA replication initiation and E2F-driven cell cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are E2F-regulated G1/S transition and replication origin initiation and unwinding, framed as the proliferative S-phase entry of the cell cycle.

shared: regulation of cilium beat frequency involved in ciliary motility
Trafficking of myristoylated proteins to the cilium

reading_1.theme: Ciliary protein trafficking and ciliogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are targeting of membrane and lipidated cargo into the cilium (ARL13B, BBSome, VxPx) and cilium assembly, framed as part of building a functional cilium from basal body docking and transition zone.

reading_2.theme: Ciliary protein trafficking and ciliogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cargo targeting of membrane proteins into the cilium (BBSome, ARL13B-INPP5E, VxPx, myristoylated proteins), framed as the delivery side of cilium assembly that works with intraflagellar transport.

shared: Defective Base Excision Repair Associated with NEIL3
Recognition and association of DNA glycosylase with site containing an affected purine
Recognition and association of DNA glycosylase with site containing an affected pyrimidine
APEX1-Independent Resolution of AP Sites via the Single Nucleotide Replacement Pathway
Defective Base Excision Repair Associated with NEIL1

reading_1.theme: Base excision repair and DNA damage reversal
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glycosylase-initiated base excision repair (NEIL1/NEIL3 lesion recognition and cleavage, AP-site and single-strand break processing), framed as the excision route that also completes TDG-mediated active DNA demethylation and complements direct alkylation reversal.

reading_2.theme: Base excision repair of damaged DNA bases
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged purines and pyrimidines, NEIL1/NEIL3 function including crosslink resolution, and AP site handling, framed as the damage-recognition and initiating steps of base excision repair, completed by the gap-filling and long-patch steps in the additional pathways.

positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction
PI5P, PP2A and IER3 Regulate PI3K/AKT Signaling

reading_1.theme: Insulin/IGF receptor signalling through PI3K-AKT and RAS
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the receptor-proximal insulin/IGF1R signalling events (IRS and SHC/SOS adaptors, PI3K-AKT activation, glycogen synthesis, attenuation), framed as the upstream growth-factor input whose AKT and RAS branches are dysregulated in cancer and RASopathies.

reading_2.theme: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IRS/PI3K/AKT signaling downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptors, framed as the effector arm of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling that also feeds ERK.

shared: Acyl chain remodeling of DAG and TAG

reading_1.theme: Glycerolipid synthesis and glycerophospholipid turnover
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triacylglycerol synthesis, framed as the anabolic glycerolipid backbone pathway that is balanced by lysophospholipid hydrolysis and glycerophospholipid catabolism.

reading_2.theme: Glycerolipid synthesis: phosphatidic acid, DAG and TAG
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the core glycerolipid synthesis route (PA to DAG/MAG to TAG, plus acyl remodeling), which this theme uses as the central precursor flux that is balanced between storage triglyceride and phospholipid production by lipase and phospholipid-synthesis regulators.

shared: obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic reuptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine synthesis and catecholamine (dopamine/norepinephrine) transport and uptake, framed as presynaptic neurotransmitter clearance by DAT/NET whose defects cause parkinsonism-dystonia and orthostatic intolerance.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine biosynthesis and synaptic catecholamine/norepinephrine reuptake, framed as monoamine neurotransmitter handling of which general catecholamine and monoamine transport are the broader context.

shared: Defective GNE causes sialuria, NK and IBM2

reading_1.theme: Amino sugar and nucleotide sugar metabolism for glycosylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe synthesis of glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc via hexosamine pathway, sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac, mannose) and their disorders, framed as the substrate supply for glycosylation that the additional set extends to nucleotide sugar transport and GPI anchor synthesis.

reading_2.theme: Hexosamine and sialic acid metabolism supplying glycosylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the hexosamine and sialic acid pathways that produce UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid, framed as donor-sugar supply for protein N-glycosylation.

positive regulation of T cell differentiation in thymus
negative regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus
negative regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
positive regulation of gamma-delta T cell differentiation
positive regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus

reading_1.theme: Thymic T cell development and selection
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are thymocyte proliferation, survival and positive selection driving T cell differentiation, framed within thymic development that also includes migration and negative selection for self-tolerance.

reading_2.theme: Thymic T cell development and selection
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are thymocyte proliferation, survival, positive selection and lineage differentiation (double positive, gamma-delta) as the T cell developmental program, extended toward CD8 differentiation and costimulation.

negative regulation of tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway
negative regulation of extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway via death domain receptors

reading_1.theme: Death receptor extrinsic apoptosis and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Fas and TRAIL death receptor signaling, procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP inhibition and BID cleavage, framed as extrinsic apoptotic signaling as used notably in activation-induced T cell and thymocyte death.

reading_2.theme: Death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe FAS and TRAIL death receptor signalling, caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP inhibition and BID cleavage, framed as the apoptotic branch of death receptor signalling that, when caspase-8 is blocked, switches to RIPK-driven necroptosis.

reading_1.theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell cycle arrest
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe p53 activation and stabilization after radiation damage leading to checkpoint control, CDK inhibition and senescence, framed as the DNA-damage arm of p53 transcriptional cell-cycle arrest.

reading_2.theme: p53-driven DNA damage checkpoint and G2/M control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the DNA damage response (radiation responses, TP53 stabilisation and activation, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition, senescence), framed as checkpoint arrest whose release and mitotic re-entry the additional cell cycle pathways cover.

reading_1.theme: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation and division
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the mitotic machinery (spindle, kinetochore, cohesion, condensation, cytokinesis), framed as the general chromosome-segregation core that meiotic division adapts.

reading_2.theme: Mitosis: chromosome segregation, spindle and cytokinesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the mechanical execution of mitosis (PLK1/Aurora A control, chromosome condensation and cohesion, spindle assembly and checkpoint, centromere maintenance, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reassembly), framed as the process timed by APC/C-mediated degradation in the additional set.

reading_1.theme: Hepatic fructose and alanine flux into gluconeogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose breakdown and its inherited defects alongside alanine metabolism and gluconeogenesis, framed as carbon feeders converging via oxaloacetate on hepatic glucose production.

reading_2.theme: Gluconeogenesis, glycolysis and fructose metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are gluconeogenesis, fructose catabolism and alanine metabolism with fructose disorders, framed as hepatic routing of fructose and alanine carbon into glucose production, which the additional pathways oppose and complete with glycolysis and glucose uptake/phosphorylation.

shared: negative regulation of stress-activated protein kinase signaling cascade

[untitled BTM module] These genes outline the interface between proliferative arrest and inflammatory secretion that characterises cellular senescence. On the chromatin side, the Polycomb component BMI1 is part of the complex that ubiquitinates histone H2A to silence the CDKN2A locus and keep cells cycling, while the deubiquitinase USP16 removes that mark and opposes it, so the balance between them sets how readily a cell exits the cycle.
negative regulation of G0 to G1 transition

reading_1.theme: Cellular senescence induction and senescence-associated secretion
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, cell-cycle exit and the SASP, framed as the senescence program whose arrest is held by Polycomb-mediated chromatin silencing and cell-cycle transcriptional control.

reading_2.theme: Cellular senescence
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of senescence by oxidative stress and oncogenes, including the SASP and CDKN2A chromatin control, framed as stress-induced proliferative arrest that limits p53-mediated apoptosis.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are MYC targets and Pol I/Pol III and nucleolar chromatin regulation of rRNA expression, framed as growth-linked ribosome biogenesis controlled at the RNA polymerase I promoter.

reading_2.theme: Ribosomal RNA transcription and nucleolar growth control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of RNA polymerase I/III rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin, including MYC targets, framed as ribosome biogenesis supporting growth.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe RAS activation (SOS, GAPs) and the RAF-MEK-ERK cascade with its negative feedback and mutants, framed as the core of oncogenic RAS/RAF signalling elaborated in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Ras-MAPK signalling, feedback control and RASopathy mutants
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Ras-RAF-MEK-ERK activation and its GAP/phosphatase negative feedback including disease mutants, framed as the core MAPK module downstream of growth factor receptors.

reading_1.theme: p53 tumour suppressor regulation and DNA damage response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are p53 activation, degradation control and its checkpoint and apoptotic outputs, framed as tumour suppression by p53 whose upstream ARF defects allow escape from senescence and apoptosis.

reading_2.theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell cycle checkpoints
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover p53 phosphorylation and degradation control, p53-driven DNA repair and apoptosis, and G2/M checkpoint regulators, framed as the p53 signaling hub that integrates DNA damage into arrest, senescence or death.

reading_1.theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signaling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe NTRK3 and TRKA signaling through RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2/ARMS adaptors, ERK5 and CREB, framed as neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to MAPK cascades.

reading_2.theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the Trk (NTRK3/TRKA) receptor-proximal adaptor cascades (FRS2, ARMS, Ras, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, CREB) that relay neurotrophin signals to transcription and survival.

shared: regulation of cardiac muscle cell membrane potential
regulation of relaxation of cardiac muscle
regulation of ATPase-coupled calcium transmembrane transporter activity
regulation of calcium ion import into sarcoplasmic reticulum
regulation of cardiac muscle contraction by regulation of the release of sequestered calcium ion

reading_1.theme: Cardiac calcium cycling and contraction-relaxation control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SERCA regulation, sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium uptake and release, cardiac membrane potential and relaxation, framed as cardiomyocyte calcium handling for excitation-contraction coupling, linked to heart rate and contractility in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling and contractility
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of SERCA-mediated calcium reuptake and release in the sarcoplasmic reticulum, framed as the control of cardiac contraction force and relaxation.

reading_1.theme: Innate social, reproductive and emotional behaviors
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are behavioral phenotypes (mating, parental, aggressive, exploratory), framed as innate behaviors modulated by stress and arousal neuroendocrine signaling.

reading_2.theme: Innate social, motivated and reward behaviours
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are behavioural phenotypes (mating, parental, aggressive, exploratory, grooming, drinking, ethanol response) and amygdala development, framed as emotional and motivated behaviour circuits, which the additional pathways extend to reward learning and drug responses.

shared: negative regulation of intracellular lipid transport
positive regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle clearance

reading_1.theme: HDL biogenesis and cholesterol efflux
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport control, framed as the cellular sterol-export step that lipidates apoA-I to assemble HDL particles (lost in Tangier disease).

reading_2.theme: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are apoA-I/HDL-mediated cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis, framed as LXR-driven cholesterol export that prevents macrophage cholesterol storage and foam cell formation.

shared: positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping

reading_1.theme: Actin filament dynamics in cell shape control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover actin crosslinking, severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 nucleation control, framed as the cytoskeletal remodeling machinery that sets cell shape and polarity under Rho GTPase and ephrin signaling.

reading_2.theme: Actin filament turnover and remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are actin filament disassembly and network remodelling (severing, capping, crosslinking, caspase cleavage), framed as the turnover counterpart that enables polymerization-driven ruffling and motility.

reading_1.theme: Anion exchange, pH control and mineralization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC26/SLC4 anion exchangers (bicarbonate, chloride, sulfate, oxalate, iodide), carbonic anhydrase pH control and their channelopathies, framed as epithelial ion and pH handling that supports enamel mineralization.

reading_2.theme: Inorganic anion transport and its disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and chloride exchangers (SLC4, SLC26) and acid-base handling with their channelopathy-like diseases, framed within broader epithelial anion transport including sodium-phosphate cotransport.

obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the guidance-cue signalling (semaphorin-plexin, netrin) that steers axon extension and innervation, of which specific neuron-type axon guidance is an instance.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by netrin and semaphorin signaling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover axon extension and netrin and semaphorin-plexin guidance signaling, framed as the guidance-cue machinery of axon pathfinding, with Sema3A-mediated growth cone repulsion as the specific mechanism.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe TLR7/8/9 signalling, its regulation by TREX1 and SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5, and defective self-ligand handling, framed as nucleic acid-driven innate immunity alongside cGAS-STING and interferon-beta responses.

reading_2.theme: Endosomal TLR nucleic acid sensing and its inborn defects
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF5 and its regulation by self-nucleic-acid control (TREX1), framed as endosomal nucleic acid sensing whose trafficking and inborn deficiencies (UNC93B1, TLR3 pathway) underlie herpes simplex encephalitis susceptibility.

reading_1.theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and its negative feedback
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe RAF/MRAS activation, oncogenic MAPK mutants and the phosphatase-mediated negative feedback inactivating ERK, framed as the regulated core cascade downstream of SOS-driven Ras activation.

reading_2.theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling, oncogenic mutants and feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the negative-feedback and dephosphorylation control of the ERK cascade plus MAPK/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signalling, framed as the regulatory counterweight to the oncogenic RAS/BRAF/RAF1 activation in the additional set.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism: threonine, glycine, aromatic and proline
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame threonine-to-glycine catabolism and glyoxylate/organic acid turnover as the generic amino acid degradation core, which the additional pathways extend to aromatic (phenylalanine, tyrosine) and proline catabolism.

reading_2.theme: Threonine and glycine amino acid catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are threonine catabolism to glycine, glyoxylate metabolism and generic amino/organic acid metabolism terms, framed as catabolic interconversion of small amino acids and their keto/aldehyde acids, linked to alanine-glyoxylate transamination by the additional pathways.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are sex steroid receptor (AR, ER) transcriptional responses and chaperoning, framed as steroid hormone signalling including prostate epithelial control and progesterone/testosterone responses.

reading_2.theme: Sex steroid nuclear receptor signalling (androgen, estrogen, progesterone)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the androgen receptor transcriptional program and steroid receptor chaperoning, plus hallmark estrogen responses, framed as the common nuclear-receptor signalling core of which estrogen and progesterone receptor signalling are parallel branches.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are organism-level behaviours and sensorimotor gating (exploration, grooming, social interaction, prepulse inhibition) plus MECP2-regulated GABA signalling, framed as behavioural readouts of inhibitory neural circuit function.

reading_2.theme: Rodent behavioral phenotypes: sensorimotor, social and motor
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are behavioral readouts (exploration, prepulse inhibition, grooming, social interaction) with MECP2 links, framed as neurodevelopmental behavioral phenotypes that extend into motor coordination.

reading_2.theme: PAX3 and cadherin transcriptional control in EMT
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 targets and transcriptional regulation of the cadherins CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19, framed as transcriptional switching of adhesion programmes in neural crest and epithelial-mesenchymal transition, under the TGF-beta/BMP signalling and transcriptional repression in the additional pathways.

reading_1.theme: TNFR1 and NF-kappaB signalling regulated by ubiquitin modifications
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe TNFR1-induced NF-kB activation and apoptosis, linear ubiquitination and SUMOylation regulating transcription factor activity, framed as an inflammatory signalling switch tuned positively and negatively by ubiquitin/SUMO and deubiquitination.

reading_2.theme: TNFR1 and NF-kB signaling via linear ubiquitination
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are TNFR1-driven NF-kB regulation by linear polyubiquitination, framed as inflammatory transcription-factor control shared with IRAK1-IKK signaling from TLRs.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.

reading_1.theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell identity and germinal centre/Tfh-driven differentiation into antibody-secreting plasma cells, framed within the humoral adaptive response that also generates memory B cells via co-stimulation.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell signatures, germinal centre and Tfh differentiation and plasma cell generation, framed as humoral immunity in which B cells develop and differentiate into antibody-secreting cells.

shared: negative regulation of inflammatory response to wounding

reading_1.theme: IL-10 and IL-12 family immunoregulatory cytokine signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-20 family signalling and regulation of IL-10 production, framed as cytokine control balancing pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory immune responses, with IL-37 and other interleukins in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-10, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-20 family signaling, framed as JAK-STAT cytokines balancing inflammation alongside type III interferon and wound repair.

shared: negative regulation of meiotic cell cycle phase transition
establishment of meiotic sister chromatid cohesion
metaphase/anaphase transition of meiotic cell cycle
negative regulation of meiotic nuclear division
negative regulation of meiotic chromosome separation

reading_1.theme: Meiotic chromosome segregation and oocyte meiosis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are meiotic cohesion, chiasma formation, chromosome alignment, segregation and meiotic checkpoints, framed as the chromosome mechanics of meiosis, particularly female meiosis with spindle positioning and polar body extrusion.

reading_2.theme: Meiotic chromosome cohesion and segregation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasma assembly, spindle alignment, checkpoint signalling and metaphase-anaphase control, framed as accurate chromosome segregation in (female) meiosis, preceded by the DSB formation and synapsis steps in the additional pathways.

shared: regulation of secondary heart field cardioblast proliferation
vasculogenesis involved in coronary vascular morphogenesis
regulation of cardiac muscle tissue development
cardiac vascular smooth muscle cell differentiation
left ventricular cardiac muscle tissue morphogenesis
apoptotic process involved in heart morphogenesis
positive regulation of cell proliferation involved in heart morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Heart morphogenesis and cardiac lineage development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe myocardial, endocardial, septal, valve and outflow vessel morphogenesis and cardiomyocyte differentiation, framed as chamber and septum formation following heart field specification, heart tube patterning and conduction system development.

reading_2.theme: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover ventricular and atrial myocardium formation, trabeculation, septation, endocardium and coronary vessel development, framed as cardiac morphogenesis that includes endocardial cushion EMT forming the heart valves.

shared: regulation of respiratory gaseous exchange by nervous system process

reading_1.theme: Hindbrain, cerebellar and basal ganglia development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe brainstem/pons and cerebellar Purkinje layer development with motor learning and respiratory control, framed as maturation of motor-control regions of the brain together with striatal development.

reading_2.theme: Hindbrain and cerebellar development underlying motor behaviour
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern development of the hindbrain, brainstem, pons and cerebellar Purkinje layer plus motor learning and respiratory control, framed as building the neural circuits that produce posture, locomotion, reflexes and other motor behaviours.

shared: meiotic cell cycle process involved in oocyte maturation
positive regulation of follicle-stimulating hormone secretion
cellular response to follicle-stimulating hormone stimulus
cellular response to luteinizing hormone stimulus
positive regulation of luteinizing hormone secretion

reading_1.theme: Gonadotropin-regulated ovarian follicle development and ovulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are FSH/LH-driven follicle growth and oocyte maturation and gonadotropin secretion control, framed within the reproductive hormone axis including activin/follistatin, ovulation and luteinization.

reading_2.theme: Gonadotropin control of gonadal follicle and germ cell development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe FSH/LH secretion and response, ovarian follicle growth, oocyte maturation and Sertoli cell proliferation, framed as the gonadotropin-driven endocrine regulation of gametogenesis in both sexes.

shared: Regulation of gene expression in early pancreatic precursor cells
Developmental Lineage of Multipotent Pancreatic Progenitor Cells
epithelial cell differentiation involved in prostate gland development
regulation of branching involved in prostate gland morphogenesis
Regulation of gene expression in endocrine-committed (NEUROG3+) progenitor cells

reading_1.theme: Pancreatic and urogenital gland development and gonad differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover lineage specification and branching morphogenesis of glandular epithelia (pancreas, prostate, reproductive tract), read alongside gonadal development and sex determination programmes.

reading_2.theme: Development of glandular reproductive and endocrine epithelia
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glandular organogenesis and epithelial lineage specification (prostate branching, genital tract, pancreatic and adrenal/neuroendocrine differentiation), read here as the general branching-gland epithelial program that mammary gland development also follows.

shared: Activated NOTCH1 Transmits Signal to the Nucleus
Constitutive Signaling by NOTCH1 PEST Domain Mutants
NOTCH2 Activation and Transmission of Signal to the Nucleus
Constitutive Signaling by NOTCH1 t(7;9)(NOTCH1:M1580_K2555) Translocation Mutant
Loss of Function of FBXW7 in Cancer and NOTCH1 Signaling
negative regulation of Notch signaling pathway
Constitutive Signaling by NOTCH1 HD Domain Mutants

reading_1.theme: Oncogenic NOTCH1 signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are activated and constitutively active (mutant) NOTCH1/2 signalling to the nucleus, framed as cancer-driving gain of Notch function.

reading_2.theme: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and oncogenic signaling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are NOTCH1/2 activation, including constitutively active cancer mutants, framed as cleavage-dependent signal transmission to the nucleus driven by regulated intramembrane proteolysis.

shared: Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
negative regulation of interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: IL-6/STAT3 and ERK MAPK signalling to AP-1
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are ERK activation and its feedback inactivation together with IL-6 JAK-STAT3 signalling, framed as cytokine-driven kinase signalling that converges on AP-1 transcription and autocrine loops.

reading_2.theme: IL-6/STAT3 and ERK signaling with phosphatase feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-6 signaling and ERK activation and its negative feedback, framed as phosphorylation-driven signaling terminated by dephosphorylation.

shared: obsolete regulation of COPII vesicle coating
positive regulation of ER to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport
retrograde vesicle-mediated transport, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum
obsolete protein localization to endoplasmic reticulum exit site

reading_1.theme: ER-Golgi bidirectional vesicle transport (COPII and COPI)
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe COPII cargo concentration and ER export together with COPI anterograde and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, framed as the early secretory shuttle whose vesicles must be tethered and targeted to and within the Golgi.

reading_2.theme: COPII/COPI vesicle trafficking between ER and Golgi
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are coat-mediated anterograde (COPII cargo loading and export) and retrograde (COPI) transport between ER and Golgi that underlies protein exit from the ER.

shared: Defective SLC17A8 causes autosomal dominant deafness 25 (DFNA25)
regulation of L-glutamate import across plasma membrane

reading_1.theme: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and recycling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are plasma-membrane reuptake of glutamate, aspartate and GABA by SLC transporters, glial glutamate-glutamine cycling and their transporter disorders, framed as synaptic clearance and recycling of amino acid neurotransmitters, ahead of the vesicular loading in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC-mediated reuptake and homeostasis of glutamate/aspartate and GABA (with transporter disease variants), framed as transmitter clearance and recycling alongside GABA synthesis/degradation and cholinergic transport.

shared: Gain-of-function MRAS complexes activate RAF signaling
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade
Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
RAS signaling downstream of NF1 loss-of-function variants

reading_1.theme: Negative feedback attenuation of RAS-MAPK/ERK signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are DUSP-type ERK dephosphorylation and feedback inhibition alongside oncogenic RAS/MAPK mutant signalling, framed as the brake on the RAS-ERK cascade that RAS GAPs reinforce.

reading_2.theme: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling: oncogenic activation and negative feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the off-switch of the MAPK cascade (ERK dephosphorylation by phosphatases, RSK-mediated negative feedback, suppression of RAS signalling and pathway mutants) that counterbalances oncogenic RAF/BRAF-driven activation.

reading_1.theme: GABA synthesis, vesicular loading and reuptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the GABAergic transmitter cycle (GAD synthesis, vesicular loading, GAT reuptake), framed as inhibitory synaptic transmission supported by vesicle acidification and related transporters.

reading_2.theme: GABA and glutamate neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the GABAergic transmitter cycle (GABA synthesis, vesicular loading, reuptake via SLC transporters), framed within the broader amino-acid transmitter turnover that includes glutamate reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling.

shared: negative regulation of dendritic spine morphogenesis
regulation of modification of postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton

reading_1.theme: Postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine structure
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are about actin-based structural organisation of the postsynapse and spine plasticity, framed as cytoskeletal remodelling (filopodia, Rho GTPases) that shapes dendrites and receptor delivery.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic spine and dendrite structural plasticity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are actin-based maintenance and remodelling of the postsynaptic density and dendritic spines, framed as the fine-scale structural plasticity of synapses within broader dendrite arborization.

shared: positive regulation of cell cycle G2/M phase transition
positive regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle
Transcription of E2F targets under negative control by p107 (RBL1) and p130 (RBL2) in complex with HDAC1
Transcription of E2F targets under negative control by DREAM complex

reading_1.theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover E2F target transcription under RB-family/DREAM repression and cell cycle phase transitions, framed as the transcriptional program that licenses cell cycle entry and DNA replication.

reading_2.theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are E2F target transcription and its DREAM/p107/p130 repression, framed as the proliferative cell-cycle gene program gated by RB and CDK4/6-cyclin control.

shared: positive regulation of cell proliferation involved in heart morphogenesis
cardiac vascular smooth muscle cell differentiation
left ventricular cardiac muscle tissue morphogenesis
vasculogenesis involved in coronary vascular morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Heart morphogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe formation of cardiac tissues (ventricular trabeculation and compaction, valves, endocardium, atrial muscle, coronary vessels), framed as heart development that includes aortic and mesenchymal contributions.

reading_2.theme: Cardiac morphogenesis: chambers, myocardium and valves
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover development of heart chamber walls, trabecular/compact myocardium, endocardium, coronary vessels and semilunar valves, framed within heart morphogenesis that also includes endocardial-cushion EMT, septation and atrioventricular valve formation.

shared: Inactivation of APC/C via direct inhibition of the APC/C complex
APC/C:Cdc20 mediated degradation of Cyclin B
Cdc20:Phospho-APC/C mediated degradation of Cyclin A

reading_1.theme: APC/C-mediated mitotic exit
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe APC/C:Cdc20 regulation and degradation of mitotic substrates (cyclins, securin, Nek2A), framed as ubiquitin-ligase control of mitotic exit including the switch to APC/C:Cdh1.

reading_2.theme: APC/C-mediated degradation controlling mitotic exit
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are APC/C:Cdc20 activity and its regulation that destroy cyclins, securin and Nek2A, framed as the early-anaphase engine of mitotic exit that hands off to APC/C:Cdh1 in late mitosis.

shared: regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance

reading_1.theme: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism: assembly, clearance and remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are about lipoprotein particle assembly and receptor-mediated clearance (VLDL, chylomicron, LDL) and cholesterol uptake/storage, the delivery-and-uptake arm of a system that also includes particle remodelling and signalling.

reading_2.theme: Plasma lipoprotein lipolysis, remodelling and clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe VLDL assembly and the clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins and LDL with cellular cholesterol uptake, framed as the downstream fate of particles that lipase-driven chylomicron remodelling produces.

shared: regulation of blood volume by renin-angiotensin
regulation of angiotensin levels in blood
renal response to blood flow involved in circulatory renin-angiotensin regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure
obsolete renal control of peripheral vascular resistance involved in regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure
nervous system process involved in regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure
positive regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure

reading_1.theme: Renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe angiotensin generation and signalling and renal control of blood volume and pressure, framed as systemic blood pressure homeostasis with renal filtration and vasopressin regulation.

reading_2.theme: Renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure and fluid volume
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin generation and signalling plus renal sodium and volume control, framed as systemic blood pressure and body fluid homeostasis that also involves thirst behaviour.

shared: Defective GNE causes sialuria, NK and IBM2

reading_1.theme: Amino sugar, sialic acid and glycosylation metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are N-acetylglucosamine, mannose and sialic acid metabolism, lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism and the GNE/MAN1B1 disorders, framed as supply and recycling of glycan building blocks that feed the UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and N-glycosylation steps and CDGs in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycan catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are hexosamine, sialic acid and mannose metabolism framed as glycan breakdown and recycling (lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism), with lysosomal sialidase, sialin export and hexosaminidase disorders as the additional context.
